current_expiry.rule: NSE individual-stock derivatives expire on the last Tuesday of the month; the September 2026 near-month cycle began after the August 25 expiry.

policy.use: Static stock knowledge may classify drivers and peers; only point-in-time events and pre-click market data may influence V3 decisions.
policy.direction_rule: Direction is assigned only from the event's intrinsic information available at publication time. Ambiguous events remain NEUTRAL with zero weight; subsequent price action is never used.

HDFCBANK.business: Large Indian private-sector bank with retail, corporate and treasury businesses.

INFY.business: Global IT services and consulting company with material North American enterprise exposure.

MARUTI.business: Indian passenger-vehicle manufacturer with domestic, export, CNG, hybrid and EV exposure.

BHARTIARTL.business: Indian telecom operator with mobile, home broadband, enterprise connectivity, data-centre and Africa exposure.

events.title: US administration proposes a permanent $103,265 fee on new H-1B visas heavily used by technology employers
events.notes: The proposal was public before the August 26 dataset start. It is classified as negative for Indian IT services because it raises potential onsite staffing costs; no later stock-price response is used.

events.title: Legal and leadership concerns weigh on HDFC Bank sentiment
events.notes: Publication date verified; next-session-open policy used because intraday publication time is not frozen here.

events.title: Infosys disclosed voluntary liquidation of step-down wholly owned subsidiaries
US August payrolls beat expectations, raising the probability of a September Federal Reserve rate hike
events.notes: The September 4 US payroll report was public before the next NSE session. Higher US rates are an intrinsic headwind for discretionary client spending and valuations in Indian IT services.

events.title: US-Iran vessel strikes and sharply reduced Strait of Hormuz traffic raise oil-supply disruption risk
events.notes: The escalation occurred over the weekend and was public before the September 7 NSE open. Higher oil and geopolitical risk are an intrinsic macro headwind for Indian equities.

events.title: Indian alternative-fuel passenger-vehicle sales exceeded petrol sales in August amid E20 concerns and high oil prices
events.notes: Maruti has material CNG, hybrid and petrol exposure, so the directional valuation impact is mixed and deliberately scored neutral. Reuters publication time was before 10:05 IST.

events.title: Maruti Suzuki announces price increases of up to 20,000 rupees on select models amid elevated costs
events.notes: Pricing can support margins but hurt demand, so the event is deliberately neutral. Reuters publication timestamp was approximately 11:39 IST; 11:40 is used as the conservative usable time.

events.title: Stronger US jobs data revived rate-hike concerns for Indian IT services
events.notes: Conservative next-session-open effective time means this market-wrap article cannot influence September 7 historical clicks. The separate September 4 US payroll event already captures the information that was genuinely known before the September 7 open.
